verdict_definition: v2, registered 2026-11-13. Lead: the average trade beats the average of every possible trade of the same length in the period, judged by resampling the rule's own trades by calendar quarter (development p < 0.05 and q < 0.1 across the run's strategy-and-entry tests; 1993-2009 p < 0.1), and CAGR is above buy-and-hold scaled to the same time in the market and the same volatility while in a trade, in both periods. The 1993-2009 period also helped choose these signals, so it is not independent confirmation; a Lead is provisional until trades after 2026-11-08 support it.

verdict_parameters.cluster: calendar quarter of the signal day
verdict_parameters.family: strategies x entry prices (close, next open) of a registered run
verdict_parameters.benchmark: buy-and-hold at exposure x (in-trade volatility / all-days volatility)

settings.funding_note: Mean US500 perp funding per daily record (zeros included), measured 2026-11-07; charged for every calendar day held through a 4 PM funding time.
